title: AI-Powered Customer Support Chatbot
raw_text: RetailMax Group is looking for a consulting partner to integrate AI capabilities into our customer support workflow. The project involves building a RAG-based chatbot that can answer product questions using our knowledge base, with escalation to human agents. Must include analytics dashboard for conversation metrics and continuous learning from agent corrections. Data privacy compliance with GDPR is required.
requirements: RAG-based chatbot with knowledge base integration
